'''Hyōtan-yama Kofun''' (瓢箪山古墳) or '''Hisago-yama Kofun''' (瓢箪山古墳) is a name commonly used for [[kofun]] (ancient Kofuns) across Japan. The name originates from the resemblance of {{ill|Zenpō-kōen-fun|en|Zenpō-kōen-fun|qid=Q11268718|lt=Zenpō-kōen-fun}} (keyhole-shaped Kofuns) to a {{ill|Gourd|ang|Cyrfæt|bg|Кратуна|bo|ཀ་པེན|chr|ᏍᏆᏏ|ckb|کوولەکە|cy|Gowrd|fa|کدو قلیایی|fr|Courge|ga|Gurd|hi|स्क्वैश (पौधा)|id|Labu|ko|박류|ky|Кабак|mg|Voatavo|mos|Wamde|ms|Labu|mzn|کیی|nl|Kalebas|nn|Kalebass|no|Kalebass|nv|Naayízí (chʼil)|ps|بينگړۍ|pt|Cabaça|scn|Cucuzza baffa|simple|Gourd|th|สควอช (ผัก)|tl|Gurd|qid=Q5339237|lt=gourd}} (瓢箪, hyōtan or hisago).
